# New American Funding

> > Direct mortgage lender offering home loans, refinancing, and comprehensive homebuyer support with specialized programs for military, Latino, Black, and LGBTQ+ communities.

New American Funding (NAF) is a full-service mortgage lender providing FHA, VA, USDA, and conventional loans alongside refinancing options. The company emphasizes inclusive lending through diversity initiatives and offers digital tools including loan calculators, a customer portal, and concierge services.

## Key Topics

- Home Loans
- Mortgage Refinancing
- FHA Loans
- VA Loans
- Cash-Out Refinance
- HELOC
- Pre-Approval
- First-Time Homebuyer
- Mortgage Rates
- NAF Cash
- NAF Homes
- NAF Concierge
- Diversity & Inclusion
- Homeownership Programs
- Loan Servicing

## Core Products & Services

- [Home Loans & Refinance](https://www.newamericanfunding.com): NAF homepage: Direct mortgage lender offering home loans, refinance, and homebuyer support
- [How to Buy a Home](https://www.newamericanfunding.com/buy-a-home): Home buying guide covering FHA loans, down payment assistance, and first-time homebuyer programs
- [Refinance Options](https://www.newamericanfunding.com/refinance): Refinancing options including cash-out refinance, HELOC, and FHA streamline programs
- [Mortgage Types](https://www.newamericanfunding.com/loan-types): Reference guide for NAF mortgage types: VA, FHA, USDA, and refinance options
- [Services Overview](https://www.newamericanfunding.com/services): NAF services overview: NAF Cash, NAF Homes, insurance, and concierge support

## Diversity & Community Programs

- [NAF Heroes](https://www.newamericanfunding.com/about-us/naf-promise/naf-heroes): NAF Heroes program offering VA loans and specialized services for military families
- [NAF Latino Focus](https://www.newamericanfunding.com/about-us/naf-promise/naf-latino-focus): NAF Latino Focus program supporting Latino homeownership and bilingual services
- [NAF Black Impact](https://www.newamericanfunding.com/about-us/naf-promise/naf-black-impact): NAF Black Impact initiative promoting Black homeownership and equity in lending
- [NAF Pride](https://www.newamericanfunding.com/about-us/naf-promise/naf-pride): NAF Pride initiative supporting LGBTQ+ community homeownership and inclusive lending
